summary: First-finish smoke test of WeAre Creators foundation. Backend auth endpoints (health, register creator/brand, duplicate 409, admin-role 422, admin login, wrong-password 401, /auth/me with/without cookie, /admin/ping RBAC, refresh, logout cookie-clear) all pass. Frontend: landing renders with all required testids, /dashboard protected redirect works, wrong-password shows inline STRING error 'Invalid email or password' (not object), admin login lands on dashboard with role tag/welcome/3 tiles, /signup?role=brand creates brand user and lands on brand dashboard with proper role-specific copy.
passed: POST /api/auth/register creator -> 200 with user + httpOnly cookies (SameSite=None; Secure; Partitioned)
POST /api/auth/login wrong password -> 401 'Invalid email or password'
GET /api/auth/me with cookies -> 200 admin user; without cookies -> 401 'Not authenticated'
POST /api/auth/logout -> 200 and Set-Cookie clears both access_token & refresh_token (Max-Age=0)
Landing (/) shows site-navbar, hero-heading, hero-cta-primary/secondary, cta-creator, cta-brand
Login page shows string error 'Invalid email or password' in login-error (not [object Object])
Admin login -> /dashboard renders role tag 'Admin · Bengaluru', welcome 'Hi WeAre Team, ...', 3 tiles (briefs/applications/payments)
Signup ?role=brand pre-selects brand, role toggle works, submit creates account and lands on brand dashboard with role 'Brand · Bengaluru' and brand-specific welcome copy
Session is cleared after logout (user redirected out of protected /dashboard)

failed.issue: After clicking nav-logout-btn from /dashboard, user ends up on /login instead of / (landing). Navbar calls navigate('/') after logout(), but ProtectedRoute on /dashboard reacts to cleared user first and redirects to /login, winning the race. Session IS cleared correctly.
failed.evidence: Playwright: after logout click, page.url == 'https://weare-bengaluru.preview.emergentagent.com/login'; nav-login-link never appeared at '/'.

action_items: Optional: In Navbar handleLogout, call navigate('/', {replace:true}) BEFORE awaiting logout(), or have logout() itself navigate, so user lands on landing (matches PRD 'Logout via navbar returns to landing'). Not blocking first finish.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (14/15 flows; logout landing target is /login instead of /)
